articles.summary: A Jacobs and AECOM joint venture has been appointed by Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII) as Program Delivery Partner for MetroLink, a transformative transportation program that will provide a high-capacity, sustainable rail connection between North County Dublin, Dublin Airport and the city center, supporting future growth, reducing congestion and enhancing mobility across Ireland's capital.
articles.title: Jacobs and AECOM joint venture appointed program delivery partner for MetroLink

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by EnergyPathways plc to provide consenting, regulatory and key Development Consent Order (DCO) activities for the MESH Energy Storage Project, a project designed to strengthen the United Kingdom’s energy security while supporting the transition to a more flexible, resilient energy system.
articles.title: Jacobs to support regulatory and consenting strategy for UK’s MESH Energy Storage Hub

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by the Oklahoma City Water Utilities Trust (OCWUT) to provide operations and maintenance (O&M) services for the city’s wastewater facilities and solids management program under a five-and-a-half-year contract, supporting reliable wastewater services for Oklahoma City and six neighboring communities.
articles.title: Jacobs to enhance wastewater system performance for Oklahoma City

articles.summary: Jacobs has been awarded a contract to support VIA Rail’s Long Distance, Regional and Remote fleet renewal program, modernizing passenger rail service across Canada with new locomotives and passenger cars designed for long-term reliability, accessibility and improved rider experience.
articles.title: Jacobs to support fleet modernization across Canada
